title: The Good Earth
author: Pearl S. Buck
summary: Wang Lung, a poor farmer in rural China in the early twentieth century, marries O-Lan, a kitchen slave. Through famine, hardship and rising fortune, he clings to the land that sustains the family.
readIf: you like plain, patient family stories about land, poverty and changing fortunes.
skipIf: you want complex plotting or are troubled by harsh depictions of women's lives.
